title: Mean as the distinguished coefficient
statement: Let $F$ be a complex Fourier system on finite sets $Ω$ and $ι$, with a full-support probability law and an orthonormal basis containing the constant-one function at a distinguished index $i_0$. For every complex-valued function $f$ on $Ω$, its mean under the law of $F$ equals its Fourier coefficient at $i_0$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a complex Fourier system on finite sets $Ω$ and $ι$
The probability law of $F$ has full support
The basis of $F$ is orthonormal and includes the constant-one function at its distinguished index
